summary: Verified 'Ver más' bug fix on /pacientes and modal regression flow. Initial grid renders 6 cards; after clicking [data-testid=perfiles-ver-mas] the grid expands to 18 cards, all fully visible (opacity=1, real bounding boxes, verified specifically 'perfil-card-bienestar-masculino-elite' and 'perfil-card-chequeo-salud-express'). The 'Ver más' button disappears after expansion. Clicking a newly revealed card opens perfil-modal with perfil-wa button. Modal closes correctly via perfil-close, Escape key, and overlay click (all confirmed with ~1s wait for framer-motion AnimatePresence).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Ver más bug (opacity:0 on new cards) is fully fixed by switching from parent staggerChildren+whileInView to per-card initial/whileInView/viewport once in ProfileExplorer.jsx. All 18 cards render visible after click; modal open/close (button/Escape/overlay) works on both initial and newly revealed cards.
rca of the issue: Previous bug: parent grid used variants with staggerChildren + whileInView + viewport once, so cards added after initial in-view trigger stayed in 'hidden' state (opacity:0). Fix: each card animates independently (initial={opacity:0,y:26} whileInView={opacity:1,y:0} viewport={once:true}), ensuring newly rendered cards animate to visible when they enter viewport.
